decisions.quote:
Most importantly, none of the moderators (need for cognition, cognitive load, forewarning) were
associated with adjustment from anchors.
decisions.reason: Studies 1 and 2 replicated Epley and Gilovich (2006, Studies 2a and 2c) to test whether need for cognition and cognitive load moderate adjustment from self-generated versus experimenter-provided anchors, and neither moderator effect replicated. The presence of baseline anchoring effects was evaluated as a data quality check rather than a co-equal central hypothesis, so the replication outcome is failed rather than mixed.

      forewarning.
decisions.reason: In Study 3, the paper conducts a preregistered replication of a separate original article, Epley and Gilovich (2005, Study 2; DOI: 10.1002/bdm.495), which is an omitted target in the shipped dataset and resulted in a failed replication.
